about: Hand file: the cb-api signer's sign-offs, one entry per route, each with the hash it was signed against. tools/api-register.cjs reads it and never writes it. A moved hash makes the sign-off stale. Only the cb-api signer edits it; a builder may delete the entry of a route the PR removes. API-STANDARD S15. One entry per line, keys sorted, so two PRs adding different routes merge clean.
